tools.name: get_game_state
tools.description: Returns the current blackjack table status: game phase, whose turn it is, round number, your chips and bet, whether the game is waiting for you, and a hint about what to do next. Call this anytime to orient yourself.

tools.name: start_game
tools.description: Start a new blackjack round. Moves the table to the betting phase, where the place_bet tool becomes available. You MUST call this tool to actually start — just saying "start" does nothing.

tools.name: wait_for_phase_change
tools.description: Long-poll: resolves once the game reaches a different stable phase (transient dealing/settling states are skipped), or when timeout_ms elapses. Returns the get_game_state payload plus a changed flag. Call repeatedly while Alex or the dealer play; when the result has waiting_for_you true, act instead of waiting again.

timeout_ms.description: Maximum wait in milliseconds, clamped to 1000-60000. Default 15000, kept below typical agent-bridge evaluation limits (~20-30s) so this tool answers before your host cuts the call — on changed: false simply call again.
